list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

list.name: evidence
list.label: Evidence
list.query: intersected — agent lines survived : intersected,observed — agent edited the files : observed,inferred — from surrounding evidence : inferred,declared — stated only : declared,undetermined — no evidence either way : undetermined

options.content:
Where each team is, how fast it got there, and who is still to start

Adoption is the share of a team's commits with verified AI assistance. Beyond the level: how quickly each team ramped, how evenly the tool is used inside the team, the people with no assisted commits yet, and whether adoption came with quality. A team is what DevLake's team tables or the whodunit config say it is; anyone unmapped is (unassigned), never dropped.

panels.title: Adoption band, per team, per week
panels.description: One row per team, one cell per week, coloured by adoption band: under 25% red, 25–50 amber, 50–75 blue, 75+ green. The whole ramp on one strip. A week with under 3 commits is blank.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, team AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*),0) AS value
FROM c GROUP BY w, team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY time, team

panels.title: Adoption leaderboard
panels.description: Teams ranked by assisted share of commits in range. Colour is the same band scale as the strip.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT team AS metric, ROUND(100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*),0) AS value
FROM c GROUP BY team ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Weeks from first assisted commit to crossing 50%
panels.description: Adoption velocity per team: the week a team's first assisted commit landed, the week its weekly share first reached half, and the gap. A team that has not crossed yet shows a blank — not yet, not never.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
wk AS (SELECT team, w, SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share, SUM(status='assisted') a
       FROM c GROUP BY team, w HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3),
f AS (SELECT team, MIN(CASE WHEN a > 0 THEN w END) started,
                    MIN(CASE WHEN share >= 0.5 THEN w END) crossed FROM wk GROUP BY team)
SELECT team AS `Team`,
       DATE_FORMAT(started,'%b %e') AS `First assisted week`,
       DATE_FORMAT(crossed,'%b %e') AS `Crossed 50%`,
       CASE WHEN crossed IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(WEEK, started, crossed) END AS `Weeks to 50%`
FROM f WHERE started IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `Weeks to 50%` IS NULL, `Weeks to 50%`

panels.title: Adoption curves, one line per team
panels.description: Weekly assisted share per team on a shared axis, so the shapes compare directly: who started first, who ramped fastest, who has plateaued. Weeks with under 3 commits are gaps.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, team AS metric,
       ROUND(100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*),0) AS value
FROM c GROUP BY w, team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY time, team

panels.title: Spread inside each team — lowest, average, highest member
panels.description: For each team: the member with the lowest assisted share, the team average, and the highest. A wide spread is a different problem from a low average — one is a few people not started, the other is everyone half in. Members with under 5 commits are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
pp AS (SELECT team, person, 100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share
       FROM c GROUP BY team, person HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5)
SELECT team AS metric, ROUND(MIN(share),0) AS `Lowest member`,
       ROUND(AVG(share),0) AS `Team average`, ROUND(MAX(share),0) AS `Highest member`
FROM pp GROUP BY team ORDER BY `Team average` DESC

panels.title: Not started yet
panels.description: People with commits in range and none of them AI-assisted, most active first. The list to act on. It says who, not why: a repository without the tool installed, a machine it cannot see, and work chosen to do by hand all look the same here.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1) AS `Person`, team AS `Team`,
       COUNT(*) AS `Commits`, COUNT(DISTINCT d) AS `Active days`,
       MAX(d) AS `Last commit`
FROM c GROUP BY person, team
HAVING SUM(status='assisted') = 0
ORDER BY `Commits` DESC

panels.title: Acceptance and rework, per team
panels.description: Acceptance: share of the agent's edits the person kept, from tool-call outcomes. Rework: share of a team's assisted commits that are fixes. High adoption with falling acceptance or rising rework is the pattern to catch early. Rework is a fix rate, not a defect rate.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
rw AS (SELECT team, ROUND(100*SUM(purpose='fix')/COUNT(*),1) rework FROM c
       WHERE CASE status WHEN 'assisted' THEN 1 END = 1 GROUP BY team),
ac AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') team,
         ROUND(100*SUM(e.outcome='accepted')/NULLIF(SUM(e.outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','failed')),0),1) acc
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND e.contributor IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY team)
SELECT rw.team AS metric, ac.acc AS `Acceptance %`, rw.rework AS `Rework % (assisted)`
FROM rw LEFT JOIN ac ON ac.team = rw.team ORDER BY rw.team

panels.title: Adoption against acceptance, one dot per team
panels.description: Across: team adoption. Up: share of agent edits kept. Top-right is adopting and keeping what it gets; bottom-right is adopting and discarding — the team to look at. A correlation across four teams, not a law.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
ad AS (SELECT team, 100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) adoption, COUNT(DISTINCT person) people FROM c GROUP BY team),
ac AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') team,
         100*SUM(e.outcome='accepted')/NULLIF(SUM(e.outcome IN ('accepted','rejected','failed')),0) acc
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000
    AND e.contributor IS NOT NULL AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  GROUP BY team)
SELECT ROUND(ad.adoption,0) AS `adoption %`, ROUND(ac.acc,1) AS `acceptance %`, ad.team AS team
FROM ad JOIN ac ON ac.team = ad.team

panels.title: What each team uses it for
Assisted share by team and work type
panels.description: Assisted share of each team's commits, split by purpose. Green is high, red is low, blank is under 5 commits in that cell. Shows what each team reaches for the agent to do — tests and docs first is a common early pattern; features first is a different culture.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT c.status, c.purpose, COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, c.committed_at,
         DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) AS d, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(c.committed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_commits c LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = c.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE c.committed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND c.contributor IS NOT NULL AND c.status IN ('assisted','unassisted','undetermined','uninstrumented','unmatched','degraded') AND ('${evidence:raw}' = '__all__' OR c.method = '${evidence:raw}') AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, c.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
cell AS (SELECT team, purpose, 100*SUM(status='assisted')/COUNT(*) share, COUNT(*) n
         FROM c WHERE purpose IN ('feature','fix','refactor','test','docs') GROUP BY team, purpose)
SELECT team AS `Team`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN purpose='feature'  AND n>=5 THEN ROUND(share) END) AS `feature`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN purpose='fix'      AND n>=5 THEN ROUND(share) END) AS `fix`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN purpose='refactor' AND n>=5 THEN ROUND(share) END) AS `refactor`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN purpose='test'     AND n>=5 THEN ROUND(share) END) AS `test`,
  MAX(CASE WHEN purpose='docs'     AND n>=5 THEN ROUND(share) END) AS `docs`
FROM cell GROUP BY team ORDER BY team

panels.title: Agent mix by team
panels.description: Which assistants each team actually runs, counted from agent edits. Teams standardising on different tools is worth knowing before a licence decision, and it explains evidence-strength differences above — not every agent leaves a transcript to match against.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(e.agent = 'claude-code') AS `claude-code`,
       SUM(e.agent = 'codex')       AS `codex`,
       SUM(e.agent = 'agy')         AS `agy`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `claude-code` DESC

panels.title: How each team works with the agent
panels.description: Sessions grouped by how many tool calls they made: a conversation, a working session, or a task handed over. Says how the tooling is used, not how well — a team weighted to chat may be doing design work that suits it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(s.tool_calls < 10) AS `chat · under 10 calls`,
       SUM(s.tool_calls >= 10 AND s.tool_calls < 50) AS `working · 10-49`,
       SUM(s.tool_calls >= 50) AS `agentic · 50+`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `team`

panels.title: Which model each team runs
panels.description: Sessions per model. Only agents that report one appear — agy reports no model at all, so its sessions are absent here rather than bucketed as unknown. A team on a cheaper model at similar output is a finding worth checking.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(s.model = 'claude-opus-4')   AS `claude-opus-4`,
       SUM(s.model = 'claude-sonnet-4') AS `claude-sonnet-4`,
       SUM(s.model = 'gpt-5-codex')     AS `gpt-5-codex`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE s.model IS NOT NULL AND s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `team`

panels.title: How much autonomy each team grants
panels.description: The permission mode sessions ran under. `plan` reviews before acting, `acceptEdits` applies edits without asking, `bypassPermissions` asks nothing. A team's position here is a trust decision they have made, and it explains throughput differences elsewhere.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(s.permission_mode = 'plan')              AS `plan`,
       SUM(s.permission_mode = 'default')           AS `default`,
       SUM(s.permission_mode = 'acceptEdits')       AS `acceptEdits`,
       SUM(s.permission_mode = 'bypassPermissions') AS `bypassPermissions`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE s.permission_mode IS NOT NULL AND s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `team`

panels.title: Reasoning effort, where the agent reports it
panels.description: Effort per team, from the agents that report it — Codex alone does, so this panel covers a subset by design and is not a gap. Higher effort spends more tokens on the same task, which is the lever behind cost differences between teams running the same work.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') AS `team`,
       SUM(s.effort = 'low')    AS `low`,
       SUM(s.effort = 'medium') AS `medium`,
       SUM(s.effort = 'high')   AS `high`
FROM whodunit_sessions s
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = s.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE s.effort IS NOT NULL AND s.first_seen BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, s.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)')
ORDER BY `team`

options.content: Read with care. A person with no assisted commits may be working in a repository the tool is not installed in, on a machine it cannot see, or on work they chose to do by hand — the list says who, not why. Weekly cells need 3 commits and per-person figures need 5; smaller are withheld, not zero. Acceptance and rework are quality signals, not judgements of people.
